owner: Raphael / Universal Technology Printer / Printer-mu dependency owner
purpose: Bind official-source commercial seed/tool candidates to unresolved Printer-mu DAG nodes without converting source evidence into procurement, selection-with-evidence, certification or physical qualification.
state: SOURCE-BOUND CANDIDATES / NO PROCUREMENT / NO PHYSICAL QUALIFICATION

selection_semantics.CANDIDATE: An attributable product/tool is technically relevant enough to carry forward into sizing, compatibility, interface and coupon planning.
selection_semantics.SOURCE_ONLY: Manufacturer source supports identity and stated specifications only; no local possession, integration, measured performance or qualification is implied.
selection_semantics.SELECTED_WITH_EVIDENCE: Not used in this matrix. Requires reviewed architecture selection plus attributable integration/physical evidence.

candidates.role: 20 x 20 mm aluminium extrusion candidate for structural frame members; not itself a precision datum network
candidates.engineering_interpretation: Suitable as a source-bound modular frame candidate. Manufacturer notes extrusion squareness is not specified, so machined datum plates/kinematic referencing/metrology remain required before calling this a datum network.

candidates.model: MGN09H / MGN09HZ1HM class with matching MGNR09 rail
candidates.role: miniature recirculating linear guide candidate for precision motion
candidates.engineering_interpretation: Strong precision-guide candidate for Printer-mu sizing, but preload, accuracy class, rail length, lubrication, mounting flatness, travel and environmental compatibility remain configuration-specific.

candidates.role: 42 mm two-phase bipolar stepper motor candidate for low-consequence benchtop motion axes
candidates.engineering_interpretation: Candidate actuator seed only. Lack of encoder means closed-loop metrology must come from an external encoder or other reference; holding torque alone is not an axis-performance claim.

candidates.role: two-phase stepper power-stage / motion-driver candidate; not a safety controller

source_facts.motor_current: up to 2 A RMS / 2.8 A peak class per manufacturer overview

candidates.engineering_interpretation: Useful motion-driver seed with diagnostics and current control. It cannot by itself satisfy C0 deterministic machine safety, safety-rated stop, independent E-stop chain or motion-controller scheduling.

source_facts.resolution: down to 1 nm with Ti interface depending configuration

candidates.engineering_interpretation: High-resolution metrology candidate, but exact readhead/scale/interface, accuracy, scale length, thermal expansion and installation tolerance must be selected for the machine envelope. Source resolution is not assembled Printer-mu accuracy.

candidates.role: positive-pressure microdispensing tool candidate for functional paste/ink/fine-feed development

source_facts.volume_control: down to 100 pL stated by manufacturer
source_facts.viscosity_range: about 1 cP to over 1,000,000 cP across product description

candidates.engineering_interpretation: Strong SOURCE_ONLY candidate for MU-004 because it covers a broad material-viscosity range. Pressure, wetted-material compatibility, nozzle selection, curing/sintering and actual electrical/dielectric coupon quality remain separate qualification gates.
unresolved: measured line/volume repeatability on selected feeds

candidates.role: independent E-stop / safety-gate relay candidate within the C0 hardware safety chain; not the complete C0 controller
candidates.engineering_interpretation: Credible independent safety-relay seed for the hardware stop chain. Its approvals and contact ratings apply only to the exact product/application conditions; they do not certify the Printer-mu system or replace the deterministic motion controller, contactors, power removal design or risk assessment.
unresolved: risk assessment and required PL/SIL architecture

dag_advancement.C0_state: PARTIAL CANDIDATE STACK ONLY — TMC2209 motion power stage + PNOZ X3 safety relay; deterministic motion controller and full safety architecture remain UNSELECTED

next_resolution: Select machine envelope, axis count, load/inertia and travel before final frame/guide/motor sizing.
Select deterministic C0 motion controller and required safety architecture from a documented risk assessment; do not infer safety from driver features.
Bind structural-deposition and conductor/dielectric/resistive/capacitive/inductive material-process candidates to exact source properties and witness coupons.
Bind exact metrology scale/interface and uncertainty budget.
Do not procure or call any candidate selected-with-evidence until owner review and compatibility sizing close.
